name: data-stream-rows
title: Data Stream Rows
description: Streaming rows enter at the top and push older rows down with a measured slide (FLIP), each new row flashing once on arrival — the motion of a live feed, honest about the fact that data keeps arriving.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Dense
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Mechanical
Typography: Monospace
Color: Duotone

## Rules

- Interval Push: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
